author: Arnav
problem: songs lists a band's track lengths as 'M:SS' strings. Return the total length of the setlist in the same 'M:SS' format.
bug_description: Formats the seconds without zero-padding, so totals with fewer than 10 leftover seconds come out like '8:6' instead of '8:06'.

comments.accurate: Adds up the track lengths and returns the total as M:SS
comments.wrong_behavior: Adds up the track lengths and returns total minutes and leftover seconds joined by a colon
comments.wrong_location: Output format verified; check each song's minutes and seconds are parsed in the right order
